target.title: fix(ui): remove redundant esc label in file preview modal header
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Skill Workshop file preview displayed two Escape hints: a non-actionable badge beside the file count and the useful shortcut hint on the Close button.

Fixes #99027.

## Why This Change Was Made

The header is status-only, so its nested Escape badge suggested an action where none exists. This focused change removes that badge and its now-unused styles while preserving the actual Escape key handler and the Close-button shortcut hint.

## User Impact

The file preview header now shows only the file count. The footer continues to show `Close esc`, and pressing Escape still closes the dialog.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwtdcpm4pefrxn940m0gy2mf`:
  - `corepack pnpm test ui/src/components/file-preview-modal.test.ts`
  - 1 file, 5 tests passed.
- In-app browser, real `openclaw-file-preview-modal` component imported from this exact checkout:
  - dialog role: `dialog`;
  - header state: `2 files`;
  - header Escape/KBD count: `0`;
  - close control: `Close esc`, with its `.kbd` text still `esc`.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh final branch autoreview: no accepted/actionable findings.

The maintainer refresh rebases the contributor patch onto current `main`, follows the component’s new path, adds focused regression coverage, and adds changelog credit.
